Brand handover

A brand built for everyday use.

The final direction needs to make sense to the people who use it.

01

Understand the system.

A clear guide connects the logo, typography, colour, imagery, and voice. The aim is to help each touchpoint feel part of the same brand, even when different people are working on it.

02

Know the essentials.

Discuss the file formats, templates, and guidance your team needs. Agree on the handover scope as part of the project. A useful handover reflects the ways the brand will actually be used.

03

Keep it consistent.

Choose who maintains the brand assets and where the team can find them. A shared source makes everyday decisions easier and helps new work build on the established direction.
